release_notes: Release v1.0.65 improves the Windows desktop installation and first-launch experience. The PowerShell bootstrap downloads the per-user setup, verifies its SHA256 against GitHub release metadata, and starts it. The desktop opens its native window before initializing the tray and backend, avoiding the startup freeze and .NET error. The Windows release workflow packages the setup, update feed and packages, then verifies uploaded assets and checksums before publishing.
